verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation tool, so a developer inspect/handoff mode is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no such capability. Rive's docs instead pitch "no handoff": exported .riv files are consumed directly by its runtimes. Nothing shows per-layer measurements, styles, asset extraction, CSS/iOS/Android code snippets, or viewer access without an editor seat.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
